entities.summary: Rafael Díaz Aguado Salaberry (1870–1942) was a Spanish Carlist politician, active in particular during the final years of the Restoration regime and during the Second Republic. He is best known as deputy to the Cortes during two terms between 1907 and 1914. During the 1936–1939 Civil War he periodically headed the Carlist underground relief organisation Socorro Blanco, which operated as a Francoist fifth column in Republican-held Madrid.

entities.summary: Rafael Díaz Aguado Salaberry (1870–1942) was a Spanish Carlist politician, active in particular during the final years of the Restoration regime and during the Second Republic. He is best known as deputy to the Cortes during two terms between 1907 and 1914. During the 1936–1939 Civil War he periodically headed the Carlist underground relief organisation Socorro Blanco, which operated as a Francoist fifth column in Republican-held Madrid.
